item.text: The coil count and winding direction look close to the reference. The reference also appears to have flat-ground ends, so I’ll add those cuts and check the resulting shape.
I’m refining the end cuts to retain the small exposed end faces visible in the reference. The model still validates as one solid.
I’ve adjusted the pitch to bring the coil spacing and overall proportions closer to the reference. I’ll check the four views once more before exporting the STEP file.
A closer look shows tighter turns at both ends. I’m adding those closed-end coils; they should also produce the broader ground faces visible in the reference.
The closed-end version validates as a single solid. Its preview is rendering now so I can check the tighter end turns and overall height.
The six-turn version looks close in all four views, including the tighter end coils and ground faces. I’ll run the final geometry check and export `submission.step`.
